provider.edgeIntro: Edge TTS is free and doesn't require an API key. Synthesis runs through the desktop app's WebSocket bridge.
provider.realtimeDesktopOnly: OpenAI Realtime streams over a WebSocket and only works in the desktop app.
provider.realtimeIntro: Low-latency streaming voices that start speaking on the first audio chunk. Uses your OpenAI API key.
provider.voiceInstructionsPlaceholder: Speak in a cheerful, encouraging tone.
provider.xiaomiDialectPlaceholder: e.g. 东北话, 四川话, 粤语
provider.xiaomiIntro: Xiaomi MiMo TTS with style tags and dialect support. V2.5 adds VoiceDesign and VoiceClone.
provider.xiaomiStyleHint: Style tags: 开心, 悲伤, 生气, 东北话, 四川话, 粤语, 台湾腔, 变快, 变慢, 唱歌, 孙悟空, 林黛玉

stt.description: The composer's voice-input button uses your browser's Web Speech API. Pick the language you usually speak and the microphone you want to use.
stt.micPermissionHint: Grant microphone permission once for the device list to populate.
stt.title: Speech-to-text

tts.autoPlayHint: Speak each completed assistant message automatically.
tts.cacheHint: Re-use generated audio for repeated playback. Cleared with the rest of your data via Settings → Data.
tts.customSSMLHint: Override the auto-generated SSML with your own markup.
tts.description: Configure read-aloud, auto-play of assistant responses, and your preferred provider. Provider API keys are stored in your OS keyring on the desktop app, or in IndexedDB on the web shell.
tts.enableHint: When on, you can read assistant messages aloud and (optionally) auto-play them.
tts.fallbackHint: If a cloud provider fails, finish reading with the free browser voice instead of stopping.
tts.pronunciationDictHint: Map words to their pronunciation. Matched case-insensitively as whole words.

sample.en: Hello, this is a test of the text-to-speech feature.
sample.ja: こんにちは、これはテスト音声です。
sample.zh: 你好,这是一段测试语音。

tts.ssmlSampleText: Hello, this is a test of the text-to-speech feature.
tts.streamingHint: Some providers stream first-byte audio for lower latency.
